tools.name: search-subdomains
tools.title: Search Subdomains
tools.description: Search crt.name's passive index for subdomains and first-seen dates. Results can be filtered, sorted, and limited; the tool is read-only and does not test DNS or host reachability.

ai.instructions: Use Search Subdomains when the user wants to enumerate, find, filter, count, or inspect first-seen dates for subdomains of an apex domain. Pass an eTLD+1 such as example.com, not a hostname such as www.example.com. Use contains for hostname filters, first-seen-descending for newest entries, and alphabetical when the user asks for alphabetical order. Treat results as passive crt.name index records: do not claim that a hostname currently resolves, is reachable, is owned by the apex owner, or expose certificate metadata. State when truncated is true and offer a narrower contains filter when helpful.

evals.input: @crt-name show me login-related subdomains for example.com
